sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
சரணாகதி அடைந்தேன் சகம் புகழும்
அருணாசல வாசன் பதமலர் பிடித்தே
sections.translit:
saraNAgathi adaindhEn sagam pugazhum
aruNachala vAsan padhamalar piditthE
sections.en: I surrendered unto His divine feet. The whole earth sings of his glory. He dwells in the mighty Arunachala mountain of Thiruvannamalai.

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
செம்மண் மலைமீது கதிரொளி பட்டாற் போல்
இம்மண் மீது சிவனுருவாய் உதித்த ஶ்ரீரமணனை
sections.translit:
semmaN malaimIdhu kadhiroLi pattAR pOl
immaN mIdhu sivanuruvAy udhittha srIramaNanai
sections.en: He appeared radiant like the sun’s rays reflecting off the red soil on the hill of Arunachala. He appeared as a form of Lord Siva on this earth. I surrendered at the divine feet of Sri Ramana.

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
மாட மாளிகை சூழ் கூடலை விட்டு களி
ஆடலைக் காண வந்தான் பாதாள லிங்கமொடு
ஒன்றி ஞானியாய் அருளொளி விழிகளொடு
குன்றினில் குமரனாய் நின்ற வேங்கடரமணனை
sections.translit:
mAda mALigai sUzh kUdalai vittu kaLi
Adalaik kANa vandhAn pAdhALa lingamodu
ondRi njAniyAy aruLoLi vizhigaLodu
kundRinil kumaranAy nindRa vEnkataramaNanai
sections.en: Sri Ramana left his humble residence in Madurai, where he was surrounded by mansions and tall buildings. He came to witness the joyous dance of Lord Shiva in Thiruvannamalai. He became one with the Shiva lingam in the tunnel-like caves of the Arunachala mountain. He became enlightened and achieved sainthood. This Venkataramanan/Sri Ramana resided in the hills with compassionate eyes, like Lord Muruga.

notes: Bhagwan Sri Ramana Maharishi was born as Venkataraman Iyer in Trichy in Tamilnadu, India. Self-inquiry motivated him to leave home at the age of 16. He landed in the Arunachala Mountain, Shiva’s abode. He spent the rest of his life there in meditation in the tunnel caves. An enlightened Ramana became a sage and jivanmukta. Devotees across the world thronged to see him and obtain his blessings. For more on his life and teachings, see: Preface and Pages 3 and 4 of “The collected works of Sri Ramana Maharshi, Published by: V.S.Ramanan, President, Board of Trustees, Sri Ramanasramam, Tiruvannamalai, 606603, Eighth Reprint 2002.
